integrity: Direct signed-edge integration and rotational covariance proof; exact symbolic expansions, independent edgewise numerical checks for n=3..110. No claim of human, independent or formal certification; priority is subject to unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: Only real affine projection with normalized continuous arclength on regular polygon perimeters, n >= 3; not piecewise-affine finite elements, vertex counting measure, irregular curves, or higher-degree polynomial projection. The asymptotic error is not a uniform finite-n inequality.
title: A modulo-three edge-crossing law for affine least squares on regular polygon perimeters
